vit-cry-001.text: Ethereum is preparing for quantum resistance by implementing account abstraction, allowing users to migrate to quantum-safe signing without changing their transactions. If ECDSA were broken, Ethereum would transition to post-quantum signature schemes like Falcon-512 or P256 to protect funds [3].

vit-cry-003.text: EIP-4444 introduces history expiry, reducing disk usage for Ethereum nodes by pruning historical data [1]. This change saves disk space, making it easier for node operators to run full nodes without requiring large storage.

vit-cry-006.text: Quadratic funding is a method of funding projects through decentralized platforms, where donors can contribute to specific projects. Its main weakness is that it can be susceptible to collusion, as blockchain transactions are public and bribers can inspect a bribee’s onchain activity to see how they "voted [2]." [2]

vit-cry-008.text: Glamsterdam is a feature in Ethereum's Layer 1 that improves scaling by separating validation from consensus [1]. Its headline feature is ePBS (EIP-7732), which increases the data propagation window to 9 seconds, enabling higher transaction throughput [1].
